attributes.opusDisclosureMessage:
Any Gemini device purchased must be returned within 14 days of purchase to avoid a non-return fee of $120.
Purchased Gemini devices can be returned within 14 days for a full refund. Details at directv.com/CancellationPolicyStream.
Gemini device has a Limited 2-year Warranty; term details can be found at directv.com/WarrantyInformation
1Purchasing a device on an installment plan requires an installment agreement and DIRECTV service. Taxes are due at time of sale. If service is cancelled, the outstanding balance is charged.
attributes.myAttDisclosureMessage: DIRECTV: New U.S. customers only. Must prepay first 2 months of service at full price. Online orders will be shipped in 1 to 3 days by FedEx Ground® to the address provided. Non-refundable. Offer limited to 1 per DIRECTV account; 2 per household. Not combinable with select offers.

disclosureMessagesByKey.opusDisclosure:
You may cancel your DIRECTV service within 14 days of purchase to avoid charges.
Purchased Gemini devices can be returned within 14 days of purchase for a full refund. Details at directv.com/CancellationPolicyStream. Gemini devices have a Limited 2-year Warranty; term details can be found at directv.com/WarrantyInformation.
We now offer an installment plan option from Affirm for financing your Gemini device purchase. The finance rate is as low as 0% APR for well-qualified customers, with flexible payment options. Requires a credit check that will not impact your credit score. Payment options depend on your purchase amount, and a down payment may be required.
You must have DIRECTV service to purchase a Gemini device on an installment plan through Affirm. If you cancel your DIRECTV service, you remain responsible for any outstanding balance on your device installment plan.
Read this to the customers that live in California ONLY: Loans by Affirm Loan Services, LLC are made or arranged pursuant to a California Finance Lenders Law License.
